headlines.description: Dalvin Cook had 171 total yards and the game's only touchdown, helping Kirk Cousins beat his old team on the first try and carrying the Minnesota Vikings to a 19-9 victory over the Washington Redskins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cook, Vikings wear down Redskins 19-9 for 4th straight win

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw two touchdown passes to DK Metcalf, Chris Carson ran for 90 yards and a score, and the Seattle Seahawks beat the reeling Atlanta Falcons 27-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws 2 TD passes as Seattle stops Atlanta 27-20

headlines.description: Rookie Miles Sanders scored on a career-best 65-yard touchdown run and the Philadelphia Eagles snapped a two-game skid with a 31-13 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Philadelphia Eagles run over Buffalo Bills in 31-13 win

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Chicago kicker Eddy Pineiro missed a 41-yard field goal as time expired and the Los Angeles Chargers hung on to beat Chicago 17-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers, Chargers beat Bears 17-16 after Pineiro misses FG

events.name: New York Giants at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw two of his three touchdown passes to Kenny Golladay and the Detroit Lions snapped a three-game losing streak with a 31-26 victory over the slumping New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford-led Lions beat Giants 31-26 and end 3-game skid

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Ryan Tannehill threw an 8-yard touchdown pass to A.J. Brown with 6:55 left, and the Tennessee Titans rallied to beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 27-23 Sunday for their second straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans force 4 turnovers by Winston, hold off Tampa Bay

headlines.description: Adam Vinatieri made a 51-yard field goal with 22 seconds left Sunday to help the Indianapolis Colts rally for a 15-13 victory over Denver.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vinatieri's final kick gives Colts 15-13 win over Broncos

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Wide receiver Cooper Kupp caught seven passes for a career-best 220 yards, Jared Goff threw for two touchdowns and the Los Angeles Rams beat the winless Cincinnati Bengals 24-10 Sunday to make for another successful trip to London.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kupp has 220 yards receiving as Rams roll 24-10 in London

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for 373 yards and three touchdowns in his first game in more than five weeks since thumb surgery, and the New Orleans Saints won their sixth straight with a 31-9 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints triumphant in Brees' return, top Cardinals 31-9

events.name: New York Jets at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Sam Darnold went from seeing ghosts to seeing teal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets' Darnold throws 3 more picks in 29-15 loss at Jaguars

headlines.description: Tevin Coleman scored three of his four touchdowns in the first half, rookie Nick Bosa had three sacks to go along with an acrobatic interception and the San Francisco 49ers remained unbeaten with a 51-13 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday in...

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 259 yards and two touchdown passes and Bill Belichick earned his 300th career NFL coaching victory in the Patriots' 27-13 win over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Belichick wins 300th, perfect Patriots beat Browns 27-13

headlines.description: Deshaun Watson threw for 279 yards and three touchdowns, including the go-ahead score in the fourth quarter to lift the Houston Texans to a 27-24 win over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson's 3 TD passes lead Texans over Raiders 27-24

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 305 yards and three touchdowns, two of them to Aaron Jones on a big night for the Green Bay running back, and the Packers held off backup quarterback Matt Moore and the Kansas City Chiefs 31-24 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers, Jones star for Packers in 31-24 victory over Chiefs

headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers stopped beating themselves long enough to keep the Miami Dolphins winless.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers overcome slow start, drop winless Dolphins 27-14
